data.title: 泽塔 · 湖畔的情报交接
data.description: 盛夏的山间湖畔，泽塔以泳装之姿混在游人中，与线人在浅水区擦身而过。一枚防水密筒在掌心交接，无人察觉。
data.location: mountain lake shore in midsummer with swimmers and pine trees
data.action: wading in shallow lake water in a leopard swimsuit, discreetly passing a small waterproof capsule to a passerby
data.promptProse: In leopard print at a summer lake, Zeta passes the capsule palm-to-palm without breaking stride.
data.animaCaption: Sun, water, and a secret changing hands — Zeta's summer work is done in seconds.
